answer: An optical attestation protocol mitigates Sybil attacks by binding each agent to a physical unclonable function. During verification, hardware refracts a violet beam through a microscale prism to generate a unique cryptographic digest. An attacker deploying fake personas incurs a verifiable cost in specialized laser diodes and precision optical sensors per identity. However, because even a whisper of thermal drift disrupts refraction, genuine nodes suffer occasional false-rejection errors.
